protocol: 60s unloaded baseline; warmup; 30s resident idle; 300 back-to-back translations; 3 cycles of 60s unloaded baseline and 60 translations spaced at least 2s apart; final 60s unloaded baseline. Old CPU OCR remains active throughout.
notes: Translation of exact English text, not OCR images. Same frozen corpus as previous CPU evaluation.
No per-case prompt, reference, glossary, preceding dialogue or manual translation corrections provided to model.

Greedy temperature 0 and newline stop follow the original CUNI-MH model card. Exact CUNI Instruction/Glossary/Previous text/Input/Response prompt, empty glossary and history. No chat wrapper. Repetition penalty 1.0 (vLLM default in publisher example), unlike Hy-MT2 recommended 1.05; same 2048 context, 256-token ceiling, 4 CPU threads and requested full GPU offload.
Local API only; no external inference. No FrameLab source/binary or shipped model changed.
GPU measurements are whole-device. Software FPS counters are not a physical panel measurement.
Both CUNI quantizations rerun on the same desktop. Prior laptop results retained separately. All extraction and downloads finished before evaluation.
instrumentation: Direct NVML 13.615.71, memory info v2 (used excludes reserved), one sample/second; complete FrameLab CSV rows selected by phase boundaries.
